entry_points.text: User mode controls port ranges and privilege level via system calls; an alternate build reports unimplemented for both.
External interrupts enter a common gate dispatching via per-CPU lookup; 32-bit may redirect to dedicated IRQ or softirq stacks.
System vectors handle platform IPIs, posted interrupts and MSI drain, thermal with APIC ack, and IRQ-work after early ack.
ISA setup assigns legacy chip and handlers; general setup preassigns vectors and stacks; native setup installs gates and cascade unless FRED.
Jailhouse overrides hooks and validates setup; debugfs builds views; kexec probes, loads, and releases params.

exports.text: Early boot provides IDT setup plus IRQ counter display and bad-IRQ acknowledge helpers.
IO delay dispatch and init plus priority and ITMT controls are exported.
CPU offline fixup, per-CPU IRQ stack initializers, and native IRQ initialization are public.
Jailhouse predicate, jump transform, 64-bit kexec loader ops, and machine halt are visible.

hazards.text: Low stack warns with dump and optional panic; reentrancy stays on stack; unexpected and retriggered vectors need completion.
Boot stack failure is fatal; Jailhouse panics on missing or bad setup and lacks restart; jump patch halts on corrupt bytes or bad length.
Debug alloc or map failure drops the subtree; kexec rejects truncated kernels, long cmdline, missing symbols, bad placement.

invariants.text: System-vector install rejects numbers below system range and any install after done is latched, claiming each vector once.
Delay starts at configured default, may switch on firmware match unless overridden; boot text selects one of four or fails.
Port updates reject wrap and out-of-range and need privilege plus unlocked state when enabling; privilege level accepts only 0-3.
Slots separate valid from unused and shutdown; stats show when unsuppressed or reserved, clearing unavailable rows.
Wakeup defaults to no-op, replaceable with sync on reset; MSI drains pending vectors in bounded loop with rearm.
Offline scan takes no lock; thermal runs only when enabled else logs; raise no-ops without support else self-IPIs.
32-bit setup is idempotent and frees partial failure; 64-bit publishes top below end, fails cleanly, idempotent.
ITMT enable rebuilds domains only on change; jump patch builds short or near encodings and treats unexpected bytes as fatal.
Probe demands size, signature, protocol and 64-bit high-load compatibility; load honors floors and alignment; params inherit live state.
Command text is terminated with crash options ahead; memory map is a truncated prefix; EFI and seed apply only when active and ready.
Setup uses external per-CPU, mutex, bug, and debugfs helpers owned outside this dossier.

locks.text: Bitmap clear updates hardware with preemption disabled; activation defers hardware refresh to user-mode exit via flag and sequence.
Vector lookup is lock-free, taking the global lock only to reevaluate missing/shutdown entries or retrigger offline slots.
ITMT capability and enable changes hold a dedicated mutex across state, debug entries, and domain refresh decisions.
Non-boot jump transforms, queueing, and batch apply hold the text mutex; inner helper assumes it is already held.

state_machines.text: IDT moves from APIC gate creation through filling unclaimed vectors, then mapping, reloading, write-protecting, and latching done.
Delay starts at default, may switch on firmware match, moves to explicit boot choice when present which then blocks firmware changes.
Bitmap starts absent, allocates on first enable, shares on fork, duplicates on write, defers hardware refresh, and releases when empty or on exit.
Offline slots skip empty, retrigger pending with support else mark unused; ITMT support sets or clears idempotently with domain refresh.
Jump toggles NOP and jump via early or SMP poke with batching; kexec moves probe to load to cleanup cleanly.

structs.text: Thread IO pairs level with refcounted bitmap and sequence; stats rows carry symbol, label, vector; table starts unused.
ITMT tracks enable and priority files; setup nodes store addr, type, len; loader keeps one staged param pointer.
Jailhouse IRQs are edge high ISA entries; descriptor names detect and init; jump patch pairs bytes with length.
Delay selectors 0-3; MSI bound 3 and suppression UINT_MAX; cascade IRQ2; fixed APIC addrs; V1/V2 lens; two jump lens.
Min addrs 0x3000 purgatory/params, 0x100000 kernel, 0x1000000 initrd; caps 30/31; protocol 0x020C, marker 0xAA55, entry base+0x200, loader 0xD0.
